**Finding submitted: deviation (medium severity), Section 4.4 Audit Rights (p0059).**

What I found:
- Section 4.4 is the only audit/inspection right in the agreement, and it binds **Corio** (our party) to keep books and open them to inspection for verifying amounts payable to Commerce One.
- Already compliant with the preferred position: once-per-calendar-year frequency, inspection by an independent CPA reasonably acceptable to us, Commerce One bearing all inspection costs unless underpayment exceeds 5%, and no remote/system-access right.
- Gaps: notice is merely "reasonable notice" (not 30 days' written notice), timing is "reasonable times" (not business hours), and the auditor is under no express confidentiality obligation.

Redline (validated, ok:true) replaces the notice/timing phrase with 30 days' prior written notice, our normal business hours, off-site-where-practicable and no systems access, and a written confidentiality agreement with the auditor tied to Section 10 — the smallest edit that reaches the preferred position while leaving the acceptable frequency and cost-allocation bargain intact.
